items.q: Why move DRAM off the top of the A20 Pro?
items.a: PoP was a space hack from the sub-watt era. Near **5 GHz** the DRAM lid is a heat plug. WMCM parks memory beside the die and puts a lid on the compute. That is [[useful-high-frequency]], not a 10 W game loop.

items.q: What does room-temp vs fridge Geekbench tell you?
items.a: On 18 Pro they almost match. Older iPhones and Android flagships do not. The 4.93 GHz burst is holdable without a freezer.

items.q: How did the Super core get faster by getting smaller?
items.a: [[shrink-the-big-core]]: 10-wide → 9-wide, shallower queues, same ALUs, integer IPC **+3%** at 4.93 GHz. Frequency, not width.

items.q: Which IP actually grew on a same-size die?
items.a: [[npu-takes-the-die]]. CPU/GPU shrink. NPU 16 → 32 cores, area **+60%**. Their INT8: 41 → 73 TOPS.

items.q: Is the A20 Super core just a tiny M6?
items.a: No. [[a-series-m-series-split]]. Phone S-core is A20-only. M6 is a later tape.

items.q: Did the 3× vapor chamber matter in games?
items.a: Genshin 3.4 W / 38–39 °C. 鸣潮 6.4 W / 58.9 fps at 42.6 °C — watts he had never seen on an iPhone. Fan iQOO still wins. UE titles still like Android more.

items.q: Does the 18 Pro beat the 17 Pro Max on battery like the keynote said?
items.a: Pro Max yes: **10h37m** 5G, ~2 h past 17 Pro Max on ~5400 mAh. Small Pro no: +100 mAh, **7h50m**, does not catch last year's Max.
Pro fills heat / battery / charge. Air and Fold take the weird bets. 云飞: walk Android's road faster so Android has nowhere to go. Tax: 半斤 Pro Max, QLC risk on 1–2 TB.
